zones.title: Receive
zones.body: The gateway posts the end reason when the call drops or the transfer completes.

zones.title: Load state
zones.body: The session row decides the outcome.

zones.title: Outcome
zones.body: Resolved, Delegated or Closed on the case; a confirmation goes out when a booking exists.

zones.title: Close
zones.body: Chat memory purged, session finalised, end logged. Nothing of the call is retained beyond ar_events.

panels.title: AR-03 Session end
panels.body: Case outcome from the session state. Chat memory for the session is deleted here: no transcript survives the call.
